name: legacy-lione-macina-banish
about: Legacy (= Succession; Standard CR 12-2-1-3): Lione-Macina (26RBS01-045, cost 8, six green reduction symbols, text '(Legacy)') with three green EX-symbol cards (Kurapora 26RBS01-033, Sejellin 26RBS02-025, Alufrost 26RBS02-027) and one non-EX card in the Trash and no Field symbols: the three EX cards are banished (one per reduction symbol used), the cost drops from 8 to 5, the non-EX card stays in the Trash.
